# Dreame MCP Server — Comprehensive Documentation

## Overview
Dreame MCP is an industrialized FastMCP 3.4.x server for the Dreame D20 Pro Plus
(and similar DreameHome-cloud models). It controls the robot through the Tasshack
Dreame protocol (local miio and/or DreameHome cloud) with LIDAR map retrieval,
cleaning controls, and an agentic sampling workflow. FastAPI powers the REST
surface and the webapp dashboard.

## Technical Architecture
- **Core Protocol**: `custom_components.dreame_vacuum.dreame` (Tasshack ref clone,
  path via `DREAME_REF_PATH`), bootstrapped with package `__path__` stubs.
- **LIDAR Map Renderer**: PIL + Numpy + MiniRacer (JS-based PGM decoder).
- **Unified Tool Pattern**: `dreame_tool(operation=...)` portmanteau consolidates
  telemetry and control. Structured dict fetchers (`fetch_status_data`,
  `fetch_map_data`, `execute_control_data`) are shared with the REST handlers.
- **REST API**: FastAPI backend providing direct PNG/PGM/YAML map exports for
  SLAM/ROS2 (`nav2_map_server` pair).
- **State**: in-memory `_state` dict (client, connected); no database.

## Deployment Guidelines
### Environment Setup
1. Clone `https://github.com/Tasshack/dreame-vacuum` to a local path
   (e.g. `D:/Dev/repos/tasshack_dreame_vacuum_ref`).
2. Point `DREAME_REF_PATH` to that directory (`.env.example` default).
3. Configure `DREAME_USER`, `DREAME_PASSWORD`, `DREAME_COUNTRY` (cloud/maps) —
   and optionally `DREAME_IP`/`DREAME_TOKEN` for local hybrid control.
4. `uv sync` then `just serve` (fleet launcher: backend + webapp).

### Execution
`webapp/start.ps1` clears port zombies and starts backend (10894) + Vite (10895).
Dual transport: stdio when no port env is set; HTTP via `DREAME_MCP_PORT`/
`MCP_PORT`. Tauri NSIS builds embed a PyInstaller backend (`run_server.py` +
`dreame-mcp-backend.spec`).

## MCP Tools
| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `dreame_tool(operation=...)` | status, battery, map, start_clean, stop, pause, go_home, find_robot |
| `dreame_help(category=...)` | status/map/control/connection/agentic help |
| `dreame_agentic_workflow(goal=...)` | LLM plans + executes multi-step goals via ctx.sample |
| `dreame_shutdown()` | Graceful disconnect + server stop |

Prompts: `dreame_quick_start`, `dreame_diagnostics`.
Skill: `skill://dreame-operator/SKILL.md`.

## REST Endpoints
- `GET /api/v1/health` — liveness probe (connected, mode, DID)
- `GET /api/v1/status` — robot telemetry JSON
- `GET /api/v1/map` — map JSON (rooms, path, zones, base64 image)
- `GET /api/v1/map/png` — rendered floor plan PNG
- `GET /api/v1/map/pgm` + `GET /api/v1/map/yaml` — ROS2 map pair
- `POST /api/v1/control/{cmd}` — start_clean | stop | pause | go_home | find_robot
- `GET /api/v1/diagnostics` — tool list + system info (CUA smoke test)
- `POST /api/v1/shutdown` — graceful shutdown
- `GET /api/skills` — skill list
- `GET /api/logs` + `GET /api/logs/export` + `DELETE /api/logs` — activity log
- `GET /api/llm/providers` — Ollama model discovery
- `POST /api/llm/chat` — Ollama chat completion
- `GET /docs` — Swagger UI (FastAPI)

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `DREAME_USER` | DreameHome email or phone |
| `DREAME_PASSWORD` | DreameHome password |
| `DREAME_COUNTRY` | Cloud region (default `eu`) |
| `DREAME_DID` | Device id (auto-discovered when single device) |
| `DREAME_AUTH_KEY` | Refresh token from previous login |
| `DREAME_IP` / `DREAME_TOKEN` | Local miio (null-token trick when token blank) |
| `DREAME_REF_PATH` | Tasshack ref clone path |
| `DREAME_MCP_PORT` | Backend port (default `10894`) |
| `DREAME_MCP_HOST` | Backend bind host (default `127.0.0.1`) |
| `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | LLM chat base (default `http://127.0.0.1:11434`) |

## Networking Standards
- **Backend Port**: 10894 (FastAPI + MCP)
- **Frontend Port**: 10895 (Vite Dashboard)
- **CORS**: explicit origins (localhost/127.0.0.1 on both ports, tauri origins)
  + unconditional regex covering Tailscale `*.ts.net`, LAN, and CGNAT ranges.
- **Tauri**: CSP `connect-src` allows `http://127.0.0.1:10894`.

## Testing
- Mocked suite (no robot/cloud): `uv run pytest tests/ -q`
- Live suite: `DREAME_LIVE=1 uv run pytest tests/ --live`
- Webapp: `npm run biome:ci` + `npx tsc --noEmit` in `webapp/`
- Five-gate: ruff check, ruff format --check, pyright, pytest, biome+tsc

## Troubleshooting
- Backend 502 / `Unable to discover the device`: robot did not answer UDP miio —
  check `DREAME_IP`, use real `DREAME_TOKEN` or cloud creds; see
  `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`.
- Map `render_error` with `raw_b64` set: fetch worked, decode/render deps
  (`py-mini-racer`, `numpy`, `Pillow`) or ref clone are broken.
- Agentic "Workflow failed": host lacks MCP sampling; call `dreame_tool` directly.
